'''Emergency Code Fourteen''' was a code used by members of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]].

Code Fourteen was [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda's]] code signaling previously identified [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] to report to his location during a crisis.

During the [[Incident at the Jedi Temple]], Yoda had alerted [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] and [[Tahl]] to respond to this signal and report to a secure chamber.
